summary: When a device moves between networks, finding out whether it is on a new network and getting a working IPv4 setup can take a noticeable amount of time. This document collects steps drawn from experience with ARP, DHCP and IPv4 link-local addresses into Detecting Network Attachment for IPv4 (DNAv4), to cut that delay. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: When you walk into a new room, you quickly check if it is the same room or a new one, so you do not waste time asking everyone who you are again.

questions: how to reduce handover delay in ipv4
